findings: Only safe_indexnow_response_diagnostic and its POST observation field alter production AST.
Arbitrary upstream response bodies are not retained; only fixed allowlisted codes, format, byte count, false bodyRetained flag, and existing body SHA are retained.
Endpoint, user agent, retry rules, journal integration, source/build and provider behavior are unchanged.
RecursionError is caught; final negative fixture is 10,000 levels.
Journal protections fail closed on uncertain outcomes and write failures.
remainingRisks: Local review does not verify a remote commit, deployed workflow or a live IndexNow receipt.
HTTP receipt does not establish search indexing.
retryGuidance: Verify the request and public ownership evidence before a bounded resubmission; do not introduce endless 403 retries.
reviewerRole: Independent read-only code and regression reviewer
scope: Local fixed Yangpyeong publisher diagnostics only; compared with untouched hourly-direct-1400/source baseline.
